description: Render a stored scan as Markdown, JSON, SARIF or HTML. Without path the report is returned as text; with path it is written inside the app root and the absolute path is returned.

path.description: Relative path inside the app root to write the report to (for example reports/vigil.md).

scanId.description: Scan to render. Defaults to the most recent scan.

name: vigil_report
title: Render a Vigil scan report
